milestone: PUBLIC PROVENANCE RECOVERY / GENERATOR AUDIT ONLY
evidence_policy: Static public source/documentation only. Generator options and script intentions do not bind released scenarios. No matching numbers, filenames alone, or sensor similarity used as linkage evidence.
recommendation: Defer final evaluation. Obtain publisher scenario-only provenance and completeness metadata. Do not manufacture families from scenario suffixes, town/type/condition, sensor similarity, or bare seed equality.

scenario_level_randomization.assessment: The only currently supportable randomization unit among evidenced individual-scenario versus recovered-family designs is the full scenario, conditional on a future complete eligible inventory and explicit unresolved-dependence assumptions. It is a limited fallback, not a certified independent-family evaluation and not authorized here.
limitations: Scenario randomization does not eliminate latent-family leakage or establish exchangeability.
Town/type strata and a fixed random seed do not supply missing independence evidence.
A random split of a fixed catalogue supports a catalogue-specific sampling interpretation; this alone does not supply a conformal new-scenario coverage theorem.
The current protocol remains mathematically vacuous and not ready; the missing inventory/exposure clearance also remains unresolved.
assumptions_to_state: Treat full scenarios as sampling/calibration units; any between-scenario exchangeability conditional on required strata is an unverified scientific assumption.
Family/route/seed duplicates and normal/anomaly relatives may cross calibration and evaluation; the amount is unknown.

Dependence from shared town geometry, simulator settings, seeds and generator templates can affect uncertainty and calibration; no independent-family coverage or novel-route generalization claim is supported.
Conclusions are conditional on the available release catalogue and eligible scenario mix, with exposure exclusions and inventory completeness independently verified before any allocation.
A conformal coverage claim requires appropriate calibration/evaluation exchangeability and a score construction compatible with it; randomization alone does not guarantee this.

steps: Verify explicit publisher full-ID-to-parent/base-drive relations and release binding before any partition.
Construct groups from verified shared-parent/route relationships; seed equality is not sufficient by itself.
Consider transitive closure only over valid common-family relations and keep groups indivisible.
Audit cross-stratum groups, eligibility/exposure and calibration counts. Any changes to units, quotas, calibration or exposure treatment require separate authorization and sealing.

coarse_groups: Whole-town or town/type clusters could be defined from known categorical fields once inventory exists, but are not recovered drive families, may miss other dependencies, and would change the evaluation target/strata/quota behavior; no such design is adopted.

frozen_design.current_global_cutoff_math: Q=max_h Q_h remains +infinity under the parent published-count audit; no fit or score computation performed.
